abilities.name: V lateral variant
abilities.condition: On-ball while moving left or right

facts.title: Chemical reaction
facts.text: NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry announced live; activation and effect were not specified.

facts.title: Perfect Pass and Creative Dribble
facts.text: Perfect Pass range 250m instead of infinite; Creative Dribble distance reduced.

facts.title: Sae–Shidou planned rework withheld
facts.text: Follow-up explicitly says the rework was not included.

facts.title: Chemical reaction roster
facts.text: New NEL Isagi–Kaiser and NEL Nagi–NEL Reo; Hiori–Isagi and Sae–Shidou changed; Bachira–Otoya removed. Follow-up says the intended Sae–Shidou rework was not shipped.

history.title: Aiku polish and quality of life
history.text: Serpent Wall returned to C; Selfish Captain was added; Venom Clearance and Crushing Bloom effects were corrected. NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry was announced as live.

history.title: Additional awakening bars
history.text: New awakening bars announced for six styles.

history.title: Sae improvements
history.text: New V variant, Magical Turn returned, Divine Pass can trigger chemistry with Shidou. Perfection Shot gained 20% range and speed; i-frames added to Perfection Shot and Divine Pass.

history.title: Sae revamp
history.text: New base and awakening abilities and an aerial awakening variant. Ness–Kaiser reworked chemistry reported live.

history.title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
history.text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

history.title: July quality of life
history.text: New awakening bars, titles and Bachira MVP.

history.title: Sae–Shidou chemistry polish
history.text: Sae's Perfect Pass to Shidou highlights Demon Drive as the ball approaches. Tournament scoreboard resets fixed.

history.title: NEL Shidou release
history.text: New NEL evolution quest and moveset, new Mythic Shidou cutscene move and World Tournament part two.

history.title: NEL Hiori rework
history.text: NEL Hiori received a revised kit; chemistry with NEL Isagi was described and released June 7. Heel Flick returned to Magical Turn.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Original map and quality of life
history.text: Original map revamped; Sae secret awakening and MVP previews added. Yukimiya restored to Mythic and Gyro Shot returned to B.

history.title: May cutscene and skill fixes
history.text: Fixed Panther Shot direction, infinite Center of Gravity, MetaBurst steal animation, ball visibility and awakening cooldown reset bugs.

history.title: Great rebalancing
history.text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

history.title: September rebalancing
history.text: Broad rebalance and Sae crates announced.

history.title: Sae kit changes
history.text: Metavision became a passive; Creative Dash replaced V, Divine Destruction limited to near penalty area and Off Balance adjusted. Older kit snapshot.

history.title: Shidou and Sae refresh
history.text: Sae and Shidou refresh announced.

history.title: Chemical reaction system
history.text: Receiver can request a chemical reaction; a button appears to initiate it.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

history.title: April bug patch
history.text: Fixed shooting after rejoining a match following a heel flick and addressed Sae–Shidou chemistry.

history.title: World Class Sae
history.text: Sae received a new World Class kit, including Metavision.

history.title: Big Bang Drive and Isagi changes
history.text: Big Bang Drive required an airborne ball; Isagi second ability reworked and Direct Pass removed at this date. Sae awakening and flows revamped.

history.title: Slide rework and chemistry
history.text: Sae–Shidou chemistry and slide rework, private server spectating and anti-cheat changes.

history.title: February bug fixes
history.text: Fixed visual awakening freezes, ball respawn and King impact registration issues.

history.title: Reo and Nagi update
history.text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.
